_doc: Material replacements for gm_poolrooms. Hashes are Remix texture hashes (XXH64 of the top mip as uploaded), verified live in game.

water._doc: Fallback for when the RTX Water addon is not installed (it draws all water itself). Bound by the addon: every gm_poolrooms water material gets $normalmap = poolrooms_rtx/water_tag (unique hash), plus the translucent flag so Source draws the underwater geometry in the main view. Calm and flat: no normal map.

void._doc: NOTHINGNESS openings (tagged by the addon): white emitter. Its emission also lights the rooms through GI, so its colour (5000 K, a touch warmer than the 5500 K rect lights in front of it) sets the overall warmth.

panel._doc: Ceiling light panels the addon draws in the vaulted north hall (poolrooms_rtx/panel_tag); emissive, the matching rect lights carry the illumination.

plaster._doc: poolrooms/plaster: the ceilings. AI-upscaled albedo, artist normal plus fine relief, matte roughness.

gate._doc: poolrooms/gate vent grilles: rebuilt bar grid, alpha cutout (legacy alpha test state of the draw), galvanised steel.

ladder._doc: models/props_urban/pool_ladder001: stainless rails, plastic treads, enamel plate.

caustic_1._doc: Animated pool-floor caustics overlay, one class of tools/gen_caustic_mesh.py (the addon draws its cells just above underwater floors). Unordered emissive particle: blend_type 6 (kEmissive) with the legacy alpha state off, so Remix's emissive-blend override stays out and the layer never enters the water volume (a translucent layer there corrupts the water absorption). Remix composites unordered layers with weighted-blended OIT: background*(1-a) + 4*a*emission, a = luminance of the albedo, so a tiny grey albedo with a matching emission boost is effectively additive. The 5500 K colour is baked into the sheet (a bound emissive texture overrides the colour constant).
